thread:
maya: follow-up from today's partial-response/timeouts postmortem. collecting owners + deadlines. i want clear handoffs so we don't regress.
owen: i'll take the server backpressure + stream framing fixes. plan: add defensive checks when reading frames, tighten kv-cache invalidation order, and add a short-circuit to abandon stuck async flushes after 250ms. target: branch + tests by Mon 2026-03-29.
trish: i'll own client SDK changes (js + python). proposed: unified reconnect policy + opt-in prefix caching for reconnects, and expose a small diagnostics hook for broken streams. draft RFC by Fri 2026-03-26.
lee: observability + runbooks. immediate items: 1) create streaming.partial_fragment_rate metric per route, 2) add synthetic continuity check every 5m, 3) runbook section "streaming rollouts" with rollback thresholds. will publish dashboards to staging Tue 2026-03-24.
maya: good. we also want a recurring pattern check: add a monthly digest that correlates partials with heartbeat misses, deployment windows, and autoscaler events. put ownership on platform team rotation.
owen: testing notes: need a chaos job that bumps ephemeral connection churn to 500rps and flips kv-cache TTLs concurrently. @lee can you provision a canary pool for that?
lee: can do. i'll reserve canary-3 for Wed 2026-03-25 08:00-10:00 PT. will post the slot.
trish: proposed client reconnect config (RFC snippet):
```
reconnect: {
  strategy: "exp-jitter",
  base_ms: 100,
  max_ms: 4000,
  attempts: 5,
  max_parallel_reconnects: 1
}
```
we'll add telemetry for reconnect_reason and reconnect_success_rate.
maya: rollout plan: server fix canary at 3% then 15% then full over 48h if metrics stable. rollback triggers: partial_fragment_rate > 0.4% or 99p request latency +20%.
infra-bot: created TKT-4500 (server-stream-fix), TKT-4501 (client-reconnect-rfc), TKT-4502 (streaming-observability). Links: https://tracker.redwood/TKT-4500, https://tracker.redwood/TKT-4501, https://tracker.redwood/TKT-4502
owen: linking hypothesis doc: https://notes.redwood/streaming/2026-03-partials-hypothesis. earliest repro shows malformed continuation frames when kv cache flush and reorder happen.
trish: i'll add SDK integration tests that simulate server truncation mid-stream and assert graceful reconnect + resume when possible. will open PR when RFC approved.
lee: adding alert rule: alert if streaming.partial_fragment_rate > 0.2% for 10m AND reconnect_success_rate < 95% -> page oncall. will also add low-noise slack notifier for <0.2% to track trends.
maya: owners + deadlines recap:
- Owen: server framing + kv fix + perf tests -> due 2026-03-29 (TKT-4500)
- Trish: SDK RFC + tests + docs -> due 2026-03-26 (TKT-4501)
- Lee: dashboards, alerts, canary slot -> due 2026-03-24 (TKT-4502)
please add test plans to tickets: what to assert for partials/timeouts and how oncall can run smoke checks.
owen: acked, i'll include a perf benchmark and regression job.
trish: acked, will stub diagnostics hook in SDKs and add smoke script.
lee: acked, will add runbook steps + rollback checklist.
maya: scheduling a 20m sync Fri 2026-03-26 09:30am PT to confirm PRs and canary prep. if anything slips, ping me.
infra-bot: TKT-4500 assigned to owen, TKT-4501 assigned to trish, TKT-4502 assigned to lee. Created on 2026-03-23.
owen: opened branch https://github.com/redwood/inference/compare/stream-fix-4500 and added unit tests.
trish: RFC posted https://docs.redwood/rfcs/4501-reconnect-policy. starting SDK changes.
lee: dashboards live in staging: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/continuity. alert manager rules pending review in PR.
maya: thanks all. small ask before we close: include a short checklist in each PR with smoke steps for oncall and link to the canary runbook. that helped last time.
trish: will do.
owen: rolling to canary-3 after tests pass. will notify here when started.
lee: will watch metrics and post updates to this thread.
maya: tagging owners for follow-up: @owen @trish @lee. closing for now.
